notes.title: The First Odyssey Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We have had our game in development for a long time, and we have finally reached the final stage of releasing it.

On June 14th at 4:00 AM PDT The First Odyssey will be released on Steam.

We thank in advance all those who have already put the game on their wishlist, and those who will buy it. 

This is our entry as an independent studio into the game market and we will be announcing new titles soon.
